_comment: Each article appears in the Writing section. Order top-to-bottom = order on the page. First article gets the 'featured' visual treatment. Add new articles to the top of this array. The 'illustration' field is optional - leave empty string to use the default gradient backdrop.

articles.title: Automating Docker Image Vulnerability Scanning with GitHub Actions
articles.excerpt: A walkthrough on wiring Trivy into a GitHub Actions pipeline to scan Docker images for CVEs, generate JSON reports, and convert them into human-readable Markdown with Python - all on every push.
